title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Revelation 6: the Lamb opens the first six seals, with the four horses, the souls under the altar and the great earthquake.

questions.text: What did the rider on the white horse have when the first seal was opened?
questions.explanation: The text says that behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it had a bow; a crown was given to him.

questions.text: What was given to the rider on the red horse?
questions.explanation: To him who sat on the red horse was given power to take peace from the earth, and a great sword was given to him.

questions.text: What did the rider on the black horse hold in his hand?
questions.explanation: When the third seal was opened there was a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

questions.text: What did the voice in the middle of the four living creatures say must not be damaged?
questions.explanation: The voice called out the prices of wheat and barley and said, “Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

questions.text: What was the name of the one who sat on the pale horse?
questions.explanation: The text says that the name of he who sat on the pale horse was Death, and Hades followed with him.

questions.text: Over how much of the earth was authority given to the rider on the pale horse?
questions.explanation: Authority over one fourth of the earth was given to him, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals.

questions.text: What did John see underneath the altar when the fifth seal was opened?
questions.explanation: He saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God and for the testimony of the Lamb.

answers.text: Seven golden bowls full of wrath
The ark of the Lord’s covenant
The prayers of all the saints in a censer
The souls of those killed for the Word of God

questions.text: What was given to each of the souls under the altar?
questions.explanation: A long white robe was given to each of them, and they were told to rest yet for a while.

questions.text: What happened to the sun when the sixth seal was opened?
questions.explanation: There was a great earthquake, the sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

answers.text: It became black as sackcloth made of hair
A third of it was struck
It stood still over the earth

questions.text: Where did the kings of the earth, the rich and the strong hide themselves?
questions.explanation: The kings, princes, commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

answers.text: In the temple of God in the holy city
In the wilderness beyond the great river
On the ships that were on the sea
In the caves and in the rocks of the mountains
